svg.title: OPT-10 feasible box and analytic minimizer
svg.desc: The feasible box spans x from zero to one and y from minus one to one. The supplied start is at zero, zero. The independently derived minimizer is at one, minus one. The connecting segment illustrates feasibility and is not a saved iteration trace.

g.text: OPT-10 · smooth convex quadratic on a 2D box
The segment illustrates feasible points, not a saved iterate trace.
